column5: AAAAAAA! / KANTO is waiting beyond the LAB. / Observe carefully, learn directly, / and trust the POKéMON at your side. / Your fieldwork begins now.

So, we meet again. / Back in MT. MOON, I didn’t / introduce myself properly. / I’m BROCK. / PEWTER CITY’s GYM LEADER. / You showed a keen eye for / fossils out there. / But finding fragments is only / part of the story. / Understanding how they connect... / that’s where true strength lies. / There’s something I want to show / you about evolution. / But first-you’ll have to / defeat me in battle. / Let’s see what you’ve learned!ÎカÀ
I took you for granted... / and I lost. / You understood more than / just the battle.
Wait. / Take this- / the BOULDERBADGE. / And with it, the key to / the CINNABAR LAB.
AAAAAAA received the BOULDER KEY / from BROCK.
AAAAAAA put the BOULDER KEY / in the KEY ITEMS.

The BOULDERBADGE grants access / to the CINNABAR LAB. / That’s where fossils are studied / and restored. / But fossils aren’t the only way / to study the past. / Some POKéMON never vanished. / They still live... unchanged. / Deep below ROCK TUNNEL, / ancient waters shelter POKéMON / older than anything restored. / Find one. Bring it to me. / Then I’ll show you another kind / of evolution.

Hey! You made it back! / Thanks for guiding me through / ROCK TUNNEL’s currents. / The POWER PLANT is stable again, / and I learned a lot watching how / you handled the flow. / Water is beautiful because it / changes without losing itself. / Now it’s time for an official / GYM challenge. / My policy is an all-out offensive / with WATER-type POKéMON!ÎカÀ
Wow! / You’re too much! / All right! / You can have the CASCADEBADGE to / show you beat me.
You can have the CASCADEBADGE. / And with it, take this board. / It will carry you across water.
AAAAAAA received the CASCADE BOARD / from MISTY.
AAAAAAA put the CASCADE BOARD / in the KEY ITEMS.

That BADGE marks a real change / in your journey. / Keep building your FIELD AIDE / record, and outsider POKéMON / will trust you more. / A puny fish can become a mighty, / raging POKéMON. / That’s the beauty of change. / Bring me that GYARADOS. / Then I’ll show you trade evolution / with a natural held item.

So, you made it back, kid! / I’m LT. SURGE. / VERMILION CITY’s GYM LEADER. / You handled VOLT TACKLE training / without flinching. / That takes nerve! / Power isn’t handed to you. / You train until you can hold it! / But a GYM battle is combat! / No holding back! / I tell you, kid, electric POKéMON / saved me during the war! / Now show me you can stand against / real voltage!ÎカÀ
Now that’s a shocker! / You’re the real deal, kid! / Fine, then, take the THUNDERBADGE!
The THUNDERBADGE proves you / cleared VERMILION GYM! / And with it, take this pass. / It’ll get you special MART stock.
AAAAAAA received the THUNDER PASS / from LT. SURGE.
AAAAAAA put the THUNDER PASS / in the KEY ITEMS.

That pass unlocks vitamins and / battle items at POKéMON MARTS. / Power isn’t handed to you. / Use those tools and train until / your POKéMON can hold it. / Bring me a RAICHU with real / voltage. / Then I’ll show you evolution / through serious output.
VIRIDIAN FOREST

ERIKA: How fortunate. / That is just the lesson I hoped / this forest would offer. / Some POKéMON bloom only when / friendship has taken root. / That kind of evolution is a bond, / not merely a change in form. / Before I return, may I ask you for / a proper GYM challenge? / With my GYM GUIDE present, the / match will be official.
Very well. / Show me how friendship has helped / your POKéMON grow. / Let us begin.ÎカÀ
Oh! / I concede defeat.

ERIKA: You are remarkably strong. / This battle was witnessed, so it / shall stand as your GYM challenge. / I must confer on you the / RAINBOWBADGE. / áÎÇÀË / Ëカね / I saw trust in the way your / POKéMON stood with you. / Friendship can guide evolution / as surely as sunlight guides / a bud into bloom. / Please come to CELADON GYM. / There, I will give a reward for / the growth you have shown.
AAAAAAA received the RAINBOW KEY / from ERIKA.
AAAAAAA put the RAINBOW KEY / in the KEY ITEMS.
The RAINBOW KEY opens the / BERRY PATCH next door to / CELADON GYM. / Please feel free to pick the / berries growing there.
CINNABAR VOLCANO
KOGA: Fwahahaha! / You made it this far. / Together, no less. / Then the lesson has already / taken root.
KOGA grips the LAVIC STONE / with both hands... / ...But it does not move.
KOGA: Hmph! / Even quenched, it resists me. / We need more strength to lift / this stone from its resting place.
JANINE: Then I made it in time. / Father, you said togetherness / was the point of this trial.
KOGA: Hah! / You are right, JANINE. / Then we shall try together.
KOGA, JANINE, and AAAAAAA / pull with all their strength!
The LAVIC STONE breaks loose / from the volcanic rock!

KOGA: Together, we freed the / stone. / A community does not weaken / the self. / It gives strength somewhere to / stand. / Back at the GYM, this will become / the heart of new ninja tools. / But before I return, I want to / battle you here. / JANINE stands beside me as my / GYM aide. / That makes this challenge / official.
Are you ready to battle KOGA?
KOGA: Then show me the strength / you bring to your allies!
Fwahahaha! / A worthy victory!
KOGA: Fwahahaha! / You have earned the SOULBADGE! / áÎÇÀË / Ëカね / Return to FUCHSIA GYM / when you are ready. / There, the LAVIC STONE will become / tools worthy of our clan.
AAAAAAA received the SOUL PASS / from KOGA.
AAAAAAA put the SOUL PASS / in the KEY ITEMS.
POKéMON TOWER
Peace is not proven by silence / alone. / Let us see how your focus holds / in battle. / Are you ready to challenge me?
In this tower, thought and memory / press close. / Show me the shape of your will.
Your focus did not waver.
The MARSHBADGE is yours. / You met the tower’s pressure and / answered it with peaceful control. / I will return to SAFFRON GYM. / Come there when you are ready.
AAAAAAA received the MARSH FINDER / from SABRINA.
AAAAAAA put the MARSH FINDER / in the KEY ITEMS.
The MARSH FINDER senses hidden / objects nearby. / A calm mind can notice what the / eyes alone overlook.

Hah! / I am BLAINE, the red-hot LEADER / of CINNABAR GYM! / Fire is more than destruction. / Properly handled, it drives / innovation and progress! / My fiery POKéMON are ready to / test your next breakthrough! / Hah! / You better have BURN HEAL!ÎカÀ
I have burned down to nothing! / Not even ashes remain! / You have earned the VOLCANOBADGE.
Hah! / The VOLCANOBADGE proves you / survived CINNABAR GYM’s heat.

But a BADGE is only proof of what / you have already survived. / Progress asks what you can build / next! / The machine by my desk can compile / a POKéMON from research data. / Answer its sequence correctly, and / generate PORYGON yourself!

GIOVANNI: You have seen me seek / power in ruins, in industry, and / before MEWTWO itself. / Every time, you stood in my way. / Very well. / No machines. No inventions. / No stolen advantage. / Only a TRAINER and his team. / Face GIOVANNI, LEADER of the / VIRIDIAN GYM!ÎéÀ
Ha! / That was a truly intense fight. / You have won! / As proof, here is the EARTHBADGE! / áÎÇÀË / Ëカね

GIOVANNI: I chased absolute power / because I mistook control for / strength. / A creature in a vat. / A BALL that never fails. / A command no one could refuse. / But MEWTWO answered control with / defiance. / My own POKéMON answered trust. / You stood before power without / trying to own it. / You trusted your team, and they / trusted you. / That is what I had forgotten. / That is what TEAM ROCKET must / learn. / As of today, TEAM ROCKET changes / course. / No more shadows. / No more conquest. / I will begin again, not as a tyrant, / but as a TRAINER. / Farewell, AAAAAAA.

The EARTHBADGE is evidence of / your mastery as a TRAINER. / But obedience is earned through / the trust recorded in your / FIELD AIDE work. / With it, you can challenge the / POKéMON LEAGUE. / Go. Your path lies ahead.
AAAAAAA! / KANTO is waiting beyond the LAB. / Observe carefully, learn directly, / and trust the POKéMON at your side. / Your fieldwork begins now.
BROCK’s out in MT. MOON right now, / searching for fossils! You should / go find him there.
Hold up! / MISTY’s away from the GYM. / She’s investigating the water / currents running through / ROCK TUNNEL.
Hold it, kid! / LT. SURGE is away from the GYM. / He’s training in DIGLETT’S CAVE.

Excuse me! / ERIKA is away from the GYM. / She’s somewhere in VIRIDIAN / FOREST. / She mentioned searching for an / ENERGY ROOT with healing properties. / She said roots teach how living / things support each other. / She’s been gone for some time… / I should go find her.

JANINE: My father KOGA disappeared / in a puff of smoke before my eyes! / Before he vanished, he spoke of / crafting new tools from volcanic / rock found in CINNABAR VOLCANO. / I had better hurry and help my / father, our clan leader!
SABRINA left for POKéMON TOWER / after feeling a psychic pull / toward it. / She said it was likely the / gathering of a massive amount / of astral energy. / I’d better head there myself.

Hey, watch your step. These tunnels / are unstable... but that’s where the / good finds are. / You’re not just passing through, / are you? / You’ve got that look... / like you’re searching for something. / This place is full of them- / fragments of ancient POKéMON. / One fragment on its own doesn’t / tell you much... / but combine the right ones... / ...and you might get something close / to what used to live here. / If you find a fossil around / here, show it to me. / I’d like to see what you’re made of!
That’s a HELIX FOSSIL! / Sharp ridges... light structure... / This belonged to something built / for speed. / Good eye. You found something / with real historical value.
BROCK gave you a / DART FOSSIL.
AAAAAAA put the DART FOSSIL / in the ITEMS.
You’ve got a good eye. / Meet me back at the PEWTER GYM. / There’s something I want to show / you about evolution.
ROCK TUNNEL

Oh, hey! / You’re all the way out here, too? / The POWER PLANT’s been having / wild electrical surges lately. / I think underground currents in / ROCK TUNNEL are feeding into it. / There’s a POWER STATION up ahead, / but this tunnel splits around it. / Could you scout ahead and tell me / which direction I should take?
RIGHT? / All right, I’ll follow that flow.
Thanks for guiding me here! / I’ve got this generator stable / again. / But there are more surges ahead. / I’m going to follow the current.
I can hear you through the wall! / There’s a waterfall ahead, and I / can see the current branching. / Could you scout for me again and / tell me which way to take?
RIGHT? / Got it! I’ll check that branch.
That steadied another surge! / There’s still one more current / pulling deeper into the tunnel. / I’m going to follow the opening / and see where it branches.
LEFT? / Got it! I’ll follow that path.

That’s it! / The POWER PLANT is fixed, and / the currents are calm again. / All this work brought positive / change to ROCK TUNNEL. / I’m heading back to the GYM. / Come find me there, okay? / I’ve got something interesting / about evolution to show you.
DIGLETT’S CAVE

Hey, kid! / I come to DIGLETT’S CAVE / regularly to train. / Down here, I can go all out! / The powerful electric blasts from / my POKéMON are contained by the / cave walls. / While training here, I developed / an ELECTRIC-type move. / Want me to teach it? / You’ll need a POKéMON that can / learn it.
All right, kid! / Choose the POKéMON to train.
Teach which POKéMON?
RAICHU wants to learn the / move VOLT TACKLE. / However, RAICHU already / knows four moves. / Should a move be deleted and / replaced with VOLT TACKLE?
1, ËÔ2, andËÔ… ËÔ… ËÔ… ËÔŒぅ Poof! / RAICHU forgot how to / use THUNDERSHOCK. / And...Ì
RAICHU learned / VOLT TACKLE!

That’s VOLT TACKLE! / It’s reckless, high-voltage power / packed into a full-body charge. / Heh! / I like you, kid. / You’ve got the nerve to handle / real voltage. / I’ll meet you back at VERMILION / GYM. / I want a battle with you!
VIRIDIAN FOREST

ERIKA: Oh, hello. / I came to VIRIDIAN FOREST in / search of an ENERGY ROOT. / Roots are quiet things, yet they / bind a whole garden together. / A root grown here is said to heal / because the forest shares its / strength as one family. / I am certain one can be found / somewhere nearby.

ERIKA: Oh! / That ENERGY ROOT is splendid. / See how many tiny roots gather / into one strong whole? / It reminds me that families, / friends, and communities grow / best together. / If I could find one of my own, I / would gladly return to the GYM.
You’ll need two POKéMON with you / for a DOUBLE BATTLE.
CINNABAR VOLCANO

KOGA: Fwahahaha! / You have found me at work, / AAAAAAA. / I seek a LAVIC STONE, quenched / by the thermal waters of this / volcano. / Such stone can be shaped into / excellent ninja tools. / But even a stone born of fire / needs water to become useful. / So it is with people. / Community is what turns many / separate strengths into one. / Togetherness will allow us to / reach the stone. / I challenge you, AAAAAAA. / Reach the water source with me, / and prove you understand the / strength of moving together! / Now, follow if you can!

KOGA: Fwahahaha! / You kept pace through the heat / and stone. / Good. / The water source lies deeper still. / A ninja does not simply rush / toward the goal. / We watch the path, trust our allies, / and move as one.
POKéMON TOWER

This circle gathers more than / memory. / It gathers feeling, fear, grief, / and the will to remain. / I came here because the tower’s / astral energy called to me. / While listening to it, I refined / a PSYCHIC-type move. / Would you like me to teach it? / You will need a POKéMON that can / learn DREAM EATER.
Very well. / Choose the POKéMON to focus.
Teach which POKéMON?
GENGAR wants to learn the / move DREAM EATER. / However, GENGAR already / knows four moves. / Should a move be deleted and / replaced with DREAM EATER?
1, ËÔ2, andËÔ… ËÔ… ËÔ… ËÔŒぅ Poof! / GENGAR forgot how to / use CURSE. / And...Ì
GENGAR learned / DREAM EATER!

That is DREAM EATER. / It draws strength from a sleeping / foe through psychic focus. / You remained peaceful inside / the tower’s astral pull. / That emotional control is / enough for an / official challenge here.
SABRINA! / I felt the tower settle. / If a battle begins here, I will / witness it as your GYM aide.
You’ll need two POKéMON with you / for a DOUBLE BATTLE.

Now watch closely. / Some evolution happens through / interaction between TRAINERS. / Will you trade your ancient / POKéMON for my GRAVELER?
RELICANTH will be / sent to BROCK.
Bye-bye, RELICANTH!
BROCK sent over GRAVELER.
Take good care of GRAVELER!
What? / GRAVELER is evolving!
Congratulations! Your GRAVELER / evolved into GOLEM!こ /
There it is... / GOLEM. / That’s trade evolution. / A change brought about by / exchange between TRAINERS.
You brought GYARADOS? / Perfect! / Some POKéMON evolve when traded / while holding something natural. / My POLIWHIRL is holding a / KING’S ROCK. / Will you trade GYARADOS / for my POLIWHIRL?
GYARADOS will be / sent to MISTY.
Bye-bye, GYARADOS!
MISTY sent over POLIWHIRL.
Take good care of POLIWHIRL!
What? / POLIWHIRL is evolving!
There it is... / POLITOED! / A POLIWHIRL traded with a / KING’S ROCK can change into / something completely new.
Hey, kid! / You’ve got a RAICHU with real / voltage, right? / I’ve got an ELECTABUZZ holding / an ELECTIRIZER. / Trade me your RAICHU for it?
RAICHU will be / sent to CLIFTON.
Bye-bye, RAICHU!
CLIFTON sent over ELECTABUZZ.
Take good care of ELECTABUZZ!
What? / ELECTABUZZ is evolving!
Hah! / Now that’s a power surge! / That ELECTIRIZER ought to wake up / something fierce in ELECTABUZZ.

Thank you for coming. / Your challenge in VIRIDIAN FOREST / was witnessed and official. / That forest reminded me that / growth comes through friendship. / Some POKéMON even evolve when / that friendship is allowed to / flourish. / When people and POKéMON support / one another, all may bloom. / You have already earned the / RAINBOWBADGE. / Now, please accept a POKéMON / that shows how friendship can / help life bloom.
Please also accept this BUDEW. / Raise it with kindness, and one / day friendship may help it bloom.
AAAAAAA received BUDEW / from ERIKA.
Do you want to give a nickname to / this BUDEW?
BUDEW evolves through friendship / during the day. / Care for it well, and it will show / you how trust becomes growth.
KOGA: Fwahahaha! / The LAVIC STONE is secure, and / your challenge was witnessed. / You earned the SOULBADGE in / CINNABAR VOLCANO. / Accept another tool of / togetherness.
